review: tend-rooted-plants@1 (handler long.tend-rooted-plants, scope long-ex26, learning 3 with no study energy, prerequisite and dependency probe, references { target: object } so that the shared resolver accepts only one object the person sees now through v7Observe, execution duration 1, visualComponents [] with view metadata on every event, no satisfaction rule) tends an established rooted food plant within reach: a plant of a food resource with growth properties that the existing plant rule grows (growth interval above 0), not fish or a fungus (mushroom, red-fungus) and not a seedling. Every refusal costs nothing (no target, target not in view or only remembered, out of reach, an item, not eligible); reach is checked before eligibility and every ineligible target gets the same words, so a refusal reveals only ineligibility, and a remembered plant out of view is refused exactly like an unknown id. inspect calls probe's own handler (open.probe of foundation-open@1, observe mode: 1 round, 0.2 energy, its observed-state record) and adds the plant's growth contract read from the inputs of the existing evaluator (forestGrowth as openPlants calls it, with openConditions, forestClimate and longPressure): growth per ripe unit (the interval), growth so far, stock and capacity, the least rounds to the next unit at the evaluator's ceiling growthScale x maximum daylight 0.65 + 11/30 (a test confirms that no plant ever grows faster), the temperature range (no growth at minGrowth, full at optimalGrowth), the moisture need, waterlogging, harvest pressure 1/(1 + depletion/20), the period pressure and what limits growth now. The first inspection records a baseline in a persistent patch record (patch id, plant, the one square unit around it, status, baseline and latest probe values with evidence ids, counts, the last assessment, and treatment, work, inputs, soil change and last maintenance, which stay empty); later inspections report the observed change since the baseline; at most 8 records are kept and a dropped one is named. The plant model represents temperature, daylight, season, soil moisture from the ground type with drought and waterlogging hazards, harvest depletion, the growth scale, period pressure, interval and capacity, seedling establishment, and dispersal with a 0.6 m placement clearance; it represents no surface crust, compaction, nutrient or competing vegetation, and no plant's growth depends on any other object (tested). So no hand loosening or clearing can change any plant: prepare and maintain report 'no corrective work indicated' in one round at 0 energy and change nothing. The specified costs of actual work (prepare 3 rounds at 2 energy, maintain 1 round at 1 energy) are published but cannot be charged, no working depth applies because no loosening is executable, no crust, compaction or competition state was invented and no multiplier exists, so every plant regrows only under the existing rule; a 120-round run in which Wren inspects, prepares and maintains two plants is byte-identical in every object to the same run without the package. Watering is not needed: for Wren's berry and root plants ordinary soil gives moisture 0.65 against needs of 0.6 and 0.5, so the moisture factor is already 1, and no water transfer was added; where a plant needs more (a fern root at 0.65 against 0.7, or a plant on rocky ground) inspection says that water would help but that this operation carries none. Reuse: probe is called for every inspection; v7Observe bounds every target through the kernel's reference resolver; forestGrowth, openConditions, forestClimate and longPressure are read, and openPlants, unchanged, remains the only growth; navigate and gather are not called: nobody is moved, travel stays with navigate and harvest with gather at its own cost, and nothing is created, refunded or eaten. There is no labor, so nothing is left pending or paused: another action pauses nothing, a repeated call rechecks reach and eligibility, cancel closes one record (target in view) or all records (no target) without undoing or refunding anything, and death closes the open records and leaves plants, soil and items as they are. No reward: no satisfaction rule, practiceEvidence is the inspected event without a qualified flag, and open-experience.ts, gated by this revision, counts every round of it as a probe round (routine unless meaningful, never progress work), so routine, vitals, wellbeing and experience equal those of the same probe by hand (tested). Modeling assumptions: fungi and fish are not rooted plants; harvest and period pressure are limits that hand work cannot change; the best-rate bound uses no depletion, full daylight and every other factor at 1; quantity counts rounds of indicated work and stays unused; patch records are personal and reach ordinary input only through the events. The ability serializes to 2542 code units (limit 3500), every earlier package is byte-identical by its id@version digest, and the conversation test now asserts that it is the second long-ex26 package rather than the last package overall.
